content.scenario: The District Council in Bangalore is scheduled to meet to discuss consumer protection issues in the district. The Chairperson needs to decide on the meeting procedure.
content.outcome: The District Council in Bangalore shall meet at a time and place decided by the Chairperson and observe a procedure as may be prescribed, to transact its business.

user_queries: How often does the District Council meet?
What is the procedure for District Council meetings?
Who decides the meeting schedule of the District Council?
